source: Fresh read of Soup Ideas A:P; exported by canonical ID in displayed order

rubric.scope: Non-contest planning priority, not performance forecast, admission, or earned points

anchors.speed_potential: 0 none/inapplicable;1 tiny;2 narrow;3 material hypothesis;4 broad plausible bottleneck;5 dominant-path potential. No numeric speed forecast.
anchors.memory_potential: 0 none;1 transient/tiny;2 narrow saved state;3 material allocation;4 broad saved state;5 major logits/MLP representation. Allocation arithmetic is not peak.
anchors.readiness: 0 prohibited/no matching path;1 idea only;2 supplied CPU/code design or unreviewed prototype;3 locally reviewed CPU implementation;4 sealed GPU packet;5 measured matching T4 variant.
anchors.evidence_level: 0 speculation;1 source/arithmetic;2 supplied CPU/interpreter/offline report;3 local CPU semantics;4 T4 primitive/full public comparison with missing admission;5 full required admission (none currently).
anchors.ease_low_cost: 0 incompatible;1 large rewrite;2 high integration cost;3 moderate;4 narrow patch;5 trivial/local methodology.
anchors.useful_original_kernel_coverage: 0 no eligible original work;1 very small;2 small;3 material hypothesis;4 broad useful original work;5 observed >=5% every run. No additive forecast.

rubric.queue_gate: REJECT and DUPLICATE remain recorded with queue priority zero; no scores recalculated in this export.

decision_definitions.TEST_NOW: Reviewed concrete local packet ready for next bounded GPU gate; no launch authority.
decision_definitions.DEFER: Useful possible work; implementation/integration/evidence or source recovery needed, or no justified standalone rerun.
decision_definitions.REJECT: Specified prohibited/inapplicable route; preserve abstract lessons/history.
decision_definitions.DUPLICATE: Merge execution slot into named canonical mechanism, preserving source-specific refinements.

current_measured_status.summary: All four fully paired variants failed useful-own-kernel share. No official/earned competition scores. Public evaluation does not establish hidden admission. CPU proof is not T4 testing.
current_measured_status.pending_accuracy_variant: Trial006 package queued; no T4 result represented in this snapshot.

future_engineering_policy.trigger: Elapsed full candidate training command crosses 79 seconds
future_engineering_policy.action: Abort the candidate and skip remaining quality checks; preserve cache
future_engineering_policy.interpretation: User engineering cutoff, not a contest disqualification gate. Censored timing is a lower bound, not completed timing or a fabricated speedup; historical completed runs remain unchanged.

scope: Scientific project priority fields only; no raw datasets, execution source, infrastructure, account identifiers, approval metadata, cell notes or full CPU/GPU logs. Citations preserve existing catalog references; no new source audit or performance claim.
